edges.reason: numberOfTokens parameter drives the mint loop and payment requirement in mintFuego.
mintFuego uses msg.sender as the recipient of every minted token.
mintFuego branches on block.timestamp against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP, a timestamp dependency.
mintFuego performs supply addition and price multiplication arithmetic.
mintFuego assigns mintIndex from totalSupply inside the mint loop.
mintFuego enforces the MAX_FUEGO supply cap condition.
mintFuego requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
mintFuego may set startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
mintFuego multiplies FuegoPrice by numberOfTokens for the payment check.
withdrawAll is gated by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender against owner.
withdrawAll caches the contract balance in the local variable contractBalance.
withdrawAll computes each payout amount from balance and percent division.
withdrawAll reads withdrawPercents to compute payout shares.
withdrawAll iterates over withdrawAddresses to determine recipients.
withdrawAll performs external ETH transfers via send() inside a loop before any state update.
reserveFuego is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
reserveFuego mints reserved tokens to msg.sender.
reserveFuego snapshots totalSupply into the local supply variable.
setRevealTimestamp writes its argument into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setRevealTimestamp updates the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP state variable.
setProvenanceHash writes its argument into FUEGO_PROVENANCE.
setProvenanceHash updates the FUEGO_PROVENANCE state variable.
setBaseURI forwards its argument to _setBaseURI.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
setStartingIndex derives its result from blockhash of a past block, a weak randomness source.
setStartingIndex writes startingIndex with no access control, allowing anyone to trigger it.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to select the entropy block.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock resets startingIndexBlock to the current block.
constructor initializes MAX_FUEGO from maxNftSupply.
constructor computes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP by adding an offset to saleStart.

normalization_plan.reason: The numberOfTokens parameter is only meaningful as the mint count consumed by mintFuego and should collapse into it.
The revealTimeStamp parameter is a direct assignment input to setRevealTimestamp and should collapse into it.
The provenanceHash parameter is a direct assignment input to setProvenanceHash and should collapse into it.
The baseURI parameter is forwarded directly by setBaseURI to _setBaseURI and should collapse into it.
The contractBalance local merely caches address(this).balance for withdrawAll and should collapse into it.
The amount local is a transient per-iteration payout value within withdrawAll and should collapse into it.
The supply local is a totalSupply snapshot used only inside reserveFuego and should collapse into it.
The mintIndex local is a transient token id computed inside the mintFuego loop and should collapse into it.
